verdict.rationale: n8n documents a complete public REST API endpoint reference generated from its OpenAPI spec, with an interactive Scalar-powered playground on the docs site where users can test API calls. Self-hosted instances also ship a built-in Swagger UI for trying out requests. Caveats: the playgrounds run against live data with no sandbox isolation, the Swagger UI is self-hosted only, and the OpenAPI spec is not advertised as a download (docs-path probes returned 404; the spec lives in the repo). missing for 10: sandboxed/test-isolated runnable examples, independent hands-on corroboration of the playground, a publicly advertised OpenAPI download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
